reviewer: English audit worker performing actual page-by-page visual inspection of the final Old English export
method: Open each assigned 150 dpi PNG individually at original detail. Inspect the actual two-column/full-width page, text bounds, breaks, headings, font and Old English special characters. Hash/bounds checks supplement rather than replace viewing.

pages.observations: Both columns and footer are clear. Hlystan government, the long hycgan cross-reference run, and hūlic forms fit the margins; macrons, eth and hooked-e forms are legible.
Hund numeral/noun entries and the hwā/hwæt/hwæðer groups are readable. Long numeric and pronoun notes wrap within columns; the final hwider line and footer are clear.
Long hwilc/hycgan/hyngran entries stay within the columns. The I heading remains with Iacob and ic; spacing before the new letter is harmless. Macron and ligature glyphs render clearly.
I entries are legible, including īecan and iernan diagnostics, in-gān forms and the intinga note. Both lower entries end inside the text area; no clipping or broken special characters.
J and L headings remain with their entries despite deliberate section whitespace. Lǣdan diagnostics and form list fit the right column; Iuda/Johannes names and macrons are clear.
Ligature/macron and hooked-e forms are crisp across the læ/lē entries. Long lęcgean and leorningcniht lists wrap cleanly above the footer; no orphaned head or column collision.
Libban, liccian, licgan and lufian diagnostics/form lists remain readable and bounded. Līcian government is present; both columns and the final lufiend entry are intact.
M heading is attached to mā. Long manig/manigfeald and māra entries fit; mann, mǣden and mǣgen glyphs and the final mægenðrymm forms are clear.
Mæ and me entries, diagnostic labels and modal cross-references are legible. Mǣrsian/mētan form lists stay within the columns; bottom mē/meaht and męte entries do not collide with the footer.
The long mid entry stays in its column; its varied case/phrase notes remain readable. Micel, mīn, mōdor and mōnað glyphs and the lower mid-ðȳ entry are clear.
Mōtan and mugan citation notes and finite forms wrap cleanly. The N heading remains with nā; the lower mynigan and nama entries stay above the footer.
Nǣ/nē entries and negative-form cross-references are crisp. The nēalǣcan dative note is visible; the long nerian forms end within the right-column bounds.
Niman diagnostics, the restored nis cross-reference and the O transition are visible. O is attached to of, and the long of usage paragraph fits without clipping.
The long ofer and on entries are legible. The on entry continues onto page 56 as an ordinary paragraph continuation; both columns remain inside the text area and the footer is separate.
Continuation of on from page 55 is intact. Onfōn, oncnāwan, ondrǣdan, ongietan and onlīesan forms/diagnostics wrap within the columns; there are no damaged glyphs or orphaned heads.
Text and glyphs are clear, but the P alphabet heading is orphaned at the bottom of the left column; its first entry palmtwīg begins at the top of the right column. Needs heading placement correction.
R heading is attached to the first cross-references. Rǣdan/rīdan diagnostics and the degree-adverb rihtlicor entry are readable; both column bottoms and footer are clear.
S heading remains with Saba and sacc. Rīsan/rōwan diagnostics, Sanctus and sæ/seed entries fit the columns; no broken macrons or ligatures.
Sc entries and long form lists are clear, including scencan at the lower left and scęððan/scieppan at right. All lines remain above the footer and inside column bounds.
Long sculan and sęcgan/sęllan entries wrap cleanly. The corrected self wording explicitly includes person or thing; special characters and the footer are intact.
Long se/sēo/ðæt entry and pronoun forms are legible. Sęndan and sēon/sēoðan diagnostics, se-ðe and the final cross-references fit without clipping.

Singing/sitting/slaying and smith entries are readable with clear restored participle diagnostics. Long slēan and smierwan form lists remain bounded; siððan visibly has both adverb and conjunction labels.
Snīðan, sprecan and standan diagnostics and long lists wrap cleanly. Lower sōðlice/stefn entries remain above the footer; eth, macrons and ligatures are intact.
Strand and the distinct stręngðu/strengu entries are legible, as are the long sum and sunu forms. Both columns and footer are clear with no isolated headings.
The long swā entry fits its column and all paired-expression punctuation is readable. Sweotolost, swęrian and swimman forms render cleanly; no clipping at the lower swang line.
The T heading stays with tabele and tācen. Swīðor/swīðost and the long tēon entry are clear, including its past participle; lower tilian lines remain within bounds.
The very long tō usage entry fits the full left column. The long tōdǣlen/tōdǣlden source-form heading fits the right column and its note stays attached; compound forms and footer are clear.
The Þ/Ð heading stays with its first entries. Tōtwǣman/tōweorpan and numeral forms wrap cleanly; thorn, eth and length-marked ligatures are clearly distinct.
The long ðæt entry continues normally into the top of the right column without loss. The recovered ðēah ðe note is visible under ðe; cross-references and special characters remain clear.
Eth-initial noun, pronoun and servant entries are readable. The long ðing and demonstrative cross-reference blocks stay within bounds; no clipped glyphs or isolated headings.
Second-person pronoun and ðurh/þurh variants are legible, with clear thorn/eth distinctions. Long ðurhwunian forms finish above the footer; columns do not collide.
U begins at the top of the right column with its first entry. ðwēan and ðyncan diagnostics and un-prefix entries are readable; final ungesewenlic lines fit within the text area.
Un-prefix adjective forms and unnan government remain legible. The long ūp-ā-hębban diagnostic/form block fits the right column; possessives and final ūt/ūte entries are clear.
W heading stays with wafian and following entries. Short-vowel wæstm and the length-marked neighbouring forms are distinct; wæter and weaxan lists stay inside the columns.
Wel visibly includes bęt/bętst; weorðan and wēpan diagnostics and forms are clear. Both lower-column entries end above the footer without clipping.
The long wesan entry includes restored negative present nis and its form list. Wīdor/wīdost and the long willan entry are legible; right-column final lines remain within bounds.
Windan/winnan and witan entries wrap cleanly. Macron differences between witan and wītan and the long wið government paragraph are clear; no collision with header or footer.
Wiðstandan, wrēon and wrītan diagnostics/form lists fit the columns. Long woruld compounds and the lower wulf entry are readable with intact OE special characters.
Wyrcean and long wyrt compounds are legible and bounded. The Y heading remains with yfel at the lower right; that entry finishes safely above the footer.
Final dictionary entries form two short, clear columns. Ymbsęllan/ymbsittan and ȳst/ȳð are readable; the natural end-of-dictionary whitespace is clean and the footer is correct.

Full-width correction page is legible and intact. C01 explicitly preserves rejected long-vowel wǣstm versus valid wæstm; C06 distinguishes erroneous weak āgyltan from strong āgyldan. All other rejected/reconstructed forms remain clearly labelled, with no clipping or missing glyphs.

findings.description: P alphabet heading is orphaned at the bottom of the left column while palmtwīg, its first entry, begins in the right column. Keep the heading with the first entry.
